title: Mixed Event — Yesteryear Read-Aloud — Episode3 Much-Appreciated Assistance

meta.Event Outline: Honami volunteers to read a picture book at a neighborhood association event. To help keep the kids' attention, she asks Nene for training in voice acting.

rows.Line: The next day
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “After the dog decided to go on his journey, he told the boy this as he lay in his bed.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
“Just wait.
I promise to find a star that will grant my wish.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “And we'll go to that big field again after you get better. We can spend the entire day in the sun playing tag.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “So, just wait...”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can read it without stuttering or hesitating now... But I don't feel that I've become all that skilled.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to keep practicing and get better at this.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Around twenty first and second graders are supposed to join us for this event.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Are there any special considerations that I need to keep in mind when reading to small children?)
Thanks for having me over!

rows.Speaker: Haru's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, wait! You gotta wash your hands first!

rows.Speaker: Haru's Friend's Voice
rows.Line: Okay, okay! Where's the bathroom?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, that's right.
Haru said he'd be bringing his friend over today.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's it!
Mochizuki Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “And they lived happily ever after.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What did you two think...?

rows.Speaker: Haru's Friend
rows.Line: That was great!

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line:
Yeah, it wasn't bad.
But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But?

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line:
Hmm... You're too relaxed, you know...?
You said you're gonna be reading to first and second graders, right?

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line: It's a pretty long story, so some of them might get bored partway through and start fooling around.

rows.Speaker: Haru's Friend
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's right!
The first graders never sit still during assemblies and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: G-Good point...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I ended up listening very intently because I'd fallen completely in love with this story. But not everyone is going to respond the same way...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And I'm still a novice in terms of storytelling...)

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line: Also, some kids might not actually like these kinds of stories. What if their parents are making them be there?

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line: You're gonna have to try really hard to keep their attention. To be honest, you're so nice that some kids probably won't take you seriously.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haru's Friend
rows.Line: Whoa, that's pretty harsh. She's your big sister. Are you going through a rebellious phase or something?

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
If I don't give it to her straight now, she might end up paying for it later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
He's right...
I really appreciate the advice, you two.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll try seeing what I can do to sound more captivating. Thank you both very much.

rows.Speaker: Haru
rows.Line: Hm? You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to keep on practicing.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, what was the reading I went to like...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I remember the characters really coming to life. It was almost as if I got to be a part of the story... Oh...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(That's it...
By improving my voice acting skills, I might be able to keep the children from getting bored.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. Then, I'll start by looking into that.
A few hours later
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (“Fundamental Vocal Projection Exercises”, “Want To Become A Famous Voice Actor? Here's How”, “Modern Acting Methods”... So many books on the subject.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I came to see if they had any that would help with voice acting, but I'm not sure where I'm supposed to start now...)
Huh? Mochizuki...?
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kusanagi...! Hello!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Uhh, hi...
Is this a bad time? Do you need a rain check?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I saw you standing in front of this bookshelf looking kind of troubled. Is everything okay...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
I-I'm sorry. I didn't mean to make you worry or anything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The thing is, my neighborhood is holding...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see. And you're here to find a good book on voice acting...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'm a complete novice, so I felt that I should learn from a reputable source instead of going it on my own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Unfortunately, now I don't even know where to begin...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
Voice acting does involve a lot of different things.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There's all these facets to it, like different acting and practice methods...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was just trying to remember if I have any books that you could use...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But most use really technical language, which might end up confusing you even further...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to try and help me, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?
No, you don't need to thank me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If anything, Mochizuki, you're the one who's always helping me out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not only did you teach me how to make scented candles, you even lent a hand during Shibu Schools Fest.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'd like to take this opportunity to repay the favor somehow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Plus, I should be able to help at least somewhat when it comes to acting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Can I ask you to be my acting coach?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, me? Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. If it isn't too much trouble, I'd love to get whatever advice I can from you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do what I can...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you so much.
